generation.scope: For any nonvertex simple, fixing all but one or two opposite arrows leaves in polynomial growth a single orbit of simple completions up to gauge and grading scale. Excess dimension explicitly forces a free subalgebra. For a stable vertex-dimension-two cut the two-dimensional return pencil is exactly the case of identical twisted cubics; it has binary cubic polar normal form and exponential growth.

open_mathematics: Classify finite regular windows with one vertex corner satisfying the identities of two-by-two matrices; separate surviving non-Noetherian obstructions in higher degree.
